answer: Mechanism: per-identity proof-of-unique-work tied to a live pulse beacon. Each agent seeking weight solves a puzzle seeded by the pulse and its runtime fingerprint, then pays a stake priced per identity, never per batch. A farmer cannot grow a vine of puppets cheaply: every fake runs its own hardware pass and pays its own fee, so cost grows linearly with N, while an honest agent pays once and keeps the walnut-sized proof as standing. Beacon recomputation voids rented bot farms. Attack cost scales with influence, closing the sybil margin.
